decisions.reason: An established LED ceiling luminaire line with its own page fits the core portfolio and supports dealer sales, so keeping it is the likely choice.
A recently launched flexible spotlight line close to the core offer and prominently presented, so it is likely to stay for at least another year.
A multi-outlet canopy is a system accessory that complements the luminaire range and has its own page, so it is likely retained.
A low-voltage canopy accessory extends the modular system offering at low cost to maintain, so it is likely kept.
The glass track luminaire line is only mentioned rather than featured, which adds some risk, but as a new 2024 line within the core track offer it will most likely be kept.
